card.name: Digits in course listings, commas before see
card.fires_on: Digits inside course schedule lines (section numbers, class times) and commas ending a clause just before a 'see' cross-reference or a recommendation. Also linking words in syllabus policy sentences.

modes.label: Course schedule digits
modes.description: A digit inside a class section number or meeting time in a university course listing.

modes.label: Comma before cross-reference
modes.description: A comma closing a clause in a drug label, right before 'see' a section or an alternative advice.
modes.example: For other diluents<<,>> see COMPATIBILITY AND STABILITY section

modes.label: Syllabus policy wording
modes.description: A word within a course policy sentence about accommodations or late penalties.
